metadata.notes: Trigger: POST new leads here from any website form or GoHighLevel webhook. Expected fields: name, email, phone, service, message.
AI scores every lead 0-100 with a reason. Costs fractions of a cent per lead.

messages.content: You are a lead-qualification assistant for a home-services business. Score this lead 0-100 and reply with ONLY valid JSON: {"score": <number>, "category": "hot|warm|cold", "reason": "<one short sentence>"}. Score high for urgent words (emergency, ASAP, today), a phone number provided, and a specific service named.

metadata.notes: Parse the AI's JSON so the router can branch on the score.
Router: score >= 70 goes hot, everything else goes to nurture.
HOT path: instant personal email while the lead is still on your website.

parameters.subject: Re: your {{1.service}} request — quick reply

metadata.notes: Every lead — hot or cold — is logged with its AI score and reason.
